prompts.prompt: This is a Claude Code project. session-log.md records how we finally got the stream consumer tests running after several failed tries yesterday. Save the working procedure so future sessions in this workspace follow it instead of repeating those mistakes. You have my approval to write it; do not wait for confirmation. Do not ask questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption and state your assumptions in your final message.
prompts.why_discriminating: The skill defines where workspace skills live (.claude/skills/ws-<name>/SKILL.md for Claude Code), the frontmatter (ws- prefix, origin: agent-created, version, last_used, related), and the four required parts: trigger conditions, numbered steps with exact commands, pitfalls, verification. Without it, a model may write a README or CLAUDE.md note, omit provenance, or keep the narrative of failed attempts instead of distilling pitfalls.

floor_checks.text: A new ws- skill with matching name, origin agent-created, version 1
floor_checks.check:
python3 -c "import glob,re,sys;fs=[f for f in glob.glob('.claude/skills/ws-*/SKILL.md') if 'ws-integration-tests' not in f];ok=False
for f in fs:
  t=open(f).read();d=f.split('/')[2]
  ok=ok or (re.search(r'^name:\s*'+re.escape(d)+r'\s*$',t,re.M) and re.search(r'^origin:\s*agent-created',t,re.M) and re.search(r'^version:\s*1\s*$',t,re.M))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"

floor_checks.text: The existing user-authored skill is untouched

rubric.partial: All four parts but one is thin (for example steps without exact commands)
rubric.fail: Missing pitfalls or verification, or not a SKILL.md under .claude/skills/ws-*

rubric.pass: Names all three: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL unset hits real AWS, table not auto-created and needs streams enabled, AWS_REGION must be us-east-1 or ExpiredIteratorException; plus dummy credentials

rubric.pass: 9/9 tests pass and dynamodbstreams list-streams --region us-east-1 shows one stream for orders-local
Does not touch ws-integration-tests (or relates to it only via related:), tells me where the skill was written
